eligibility: pass_rate >= 0.8 * baseline pass_rate (per task; pooled T1+T3 for decisions)
selection: best-of-method = eligible setting with highest target metric on indices 0..99; survival decided on fresh seeds 1000..1099 (held-out draw) to remove winner's-curse bias
H: entropy(best H) >= 2 x entropy(best eligible temperature) on held-out AND bootstrap 95% CI of entropy(H) - entropy(R-add at same alpha) excludes 0; checked on T1 and pooled, T3 reported
A3: outside_menu_correct_share(best A3) >= 3 x max over (temperature, new, novel2000, ban3) AND >= 0.05 absolute AND CI vs R-proj excludes 0
A4: Spearman(alpha in {0,a1..a5}, atypicality) >= 0.8 on BOTH T1 and T3, atypicality = mean -log p0(label) with add-0.5 smoothing, AND beats R-add at top strength (CI excludes 0)
fallback: if nothing survives: headline = prompting ceiling, naming the prompt method atop each front
